version.author: chmaha
version.changelog: Full voice editor: every DX7 parameter as an automatable control, with an EDIT page (algorithm diagram, six operators with live envelopes, LFO, pitch envelope, key scaling) next to the PLAY page (voice grid, performance and controller settings). Dexed's performance controls: filter cutoff and resonance, mono mode, master tune, pitch-bend range and step, mod wheel / foot / breath / aftertouch routing, operator on/off switches. User cartridge of 32 slots: STORE the current voice, INIT VOICE, rename voices; saved with the project and in REAPER presets. Edited voices are saved with the project. The name now shows the original plugin (Dexed), and the GUI credits it. Listed in REAPER's Instruments folder. The voice arrows and mouse wheel stay within the current cartridge, wrapping at the ends; choosing another cartridge starts at its first voice. The cartridge file moved to its own folder (Dependencies/Jexed).
